name: Abandoned Camp
description: A small shelter has been erected under the old bridge.

name: Abandoned Car Fort
description: A once occupied fort constructed out of stacked cars now sits empty.

name: Abandoned Tent
description: A long abandoned tent still stands, shelter by a skeletal charcoal tree. The interior consists of a bed, a footlocker, a shelf, and various miscellaneous items.

name: Agatha's House
description: A small rope bridge leads to an otherwise tucked away shack and broadcast tower.

name: Alexandria Arms
description: An abandoned two-story hotel and conference center, seemingly in service to the now ruined weapon manufacturer.

name: Alien Crash Site (Mothership Zeta)
description: What appears to be a crashed alien ship rests in a crater, emitting a strange signal.

name: Anacostia Crossing
description: This metro station offers both a coastal view and access to the metro systems.

name: Anchorage Memorial
description: A massive statue celebrating Alaska's liberation was constructed over a large steam works, that even attaches to the Sewers and metro.
vendors: *Ted's Famous Mirelurk Cakes* ([Ted](https://fallout.fandom.com/wiki/Ted_(Fallout_3)), Human: Rarity 3 Food Vendor)
*Rocky's Shop* ([Rocky](https://fallout.fandom.com/wiki/Rocky "Rocky"), Ghoul: Energy Weapon Modifier)

name: Anchored Boat
description: A boat sits unbothered by the shoreline, having been anchored in the middle of the river.

name: Anchored Troller
description: This fully automated troller recently made port for one reason or another. Its fully robotic deckhands having not made shore as of yet and seem to be waiting.

name: Andale
description: This portion of pre-war suburbia and its population have seemingly become dead set on keeping pre-war America alive. The all-American lifestyle of Andale's residents is not an act either; they have lived this way ever since the Great War. During the war, their four founding families hid in their fallout shelters beneath Andale, including their descendants who still remain.
vendors: *Linda Smith's Kitchen* ([Linda Smith](https://fallout.wiki/wiki/Linda_Smith), Human: Rarity 1 Food Vendor)
*LemOnaDe 4 SaLe* ([Jack Smith](https://fallout.wiki/wiki/Jack_Smith "Jack Smith"), Human: Rarity 0 Beverage Vendor)

name: Ant Hill, Human Bones
description: A small trail of scavenged materials leads towards a dirt ringed mouth in the hills. A number of skeletons and robots along the path towards it have the tattered remains of metro worker uniforms.

name: Ant Hill, Larder
description: The rich soil around its mouth and pungent odder suggests that the residents may be eating well.

name: Ant Hill, Military Tent
description: A mound of turned dirt has half buried an old military tent, a number of metro braded robots in mixed into the soil.

name: Ant Hill, Pilfered Neighborhood
description: An innumerable number of belongs and items seem to have been drug towards a small earthen mound through the neighborhood's yards.

name: Ant Hill, Road Side
description: A small earthen mound further raises the hilltop's apex. It seems fairly isolated from the rest of the wastelands.

name: AntAgonizer's Lair
description: A recently excavated tunnel system that links into the old metro center.

name: Arefu
description: Built atop a half collapse overpass that itself bridges a river has left this settlement particularly defensible. Despite this, the settlement has seemingly been under constant attack from a innumerable number of threats.
vendors: Brailee Ewer's Kitche ([Brailee Ewers](https://fallout.wiki/wiki/Brailee_Ewers "Brailee Ewers"), Rarity 3 Food Vendor)

name: Arefu Fishing Camp
description: A number of work stations and coverings to help shelter the fisherman while they labor for the nearby town.

name: Arlington Cemetery North
description: An utter sea of grave markers populates the relatively untouched clearing in the ruins stretching outwards to the South.

name: Arlington Cemetery South
description: An utter sea of grave markers populates the relatively untouched clearing in the ruins stretching outwards to the North.

name: Arlington House
description: The Arlington House is a mansion located in Arlington Cemetery originally built as a memorial to George Washington.

name: Arlington Library
description: A large pre-war ruin, likely occupied and filled with the knowledge of a dead civilization.

name: Arlington Sewer
description: A large sewer access point that also links with the metro system.

name: Bailey's Crossroads
description: This Section of the old ruins is currently under conflict between the BOS and Supermutants. A number of ruined store fronts and skyscrapers overshadow the clearing and the metro station at its center.

name: Bank, Mason District
description: An old pre-war bank, its doors still locked and exterior relatively unblemished.

name: Bank, Pennsylvania Avenue
description: A large bank sits at the top of a grand stairway, a number of picketing skeletons having tumbled down the steps long ago.

name: Bank, Takoma Park
description: This bank advertises 50 year mortgages!

name: Bannister Crater
description: A recently decimated building resides alongside a still smoking crater.

name: Beached Boat
description: A beached boat that gouged itself onshore at one point or another.

name: Besnik's Barbershop
description: A pre-war business offering barber services.

name: Bethesda Ruins
description: A pre-war office building, likely teeming with bugs.

name: Bethesda Underworks
description: The unseemly guts of Bethesda, its nonsensical workings needing an entire sub system to function while also offering access to the metro system.

name: Big Town
description: The population of Big Town is mostly teenagers and young adults that were formerly residents of Little Lamplight, having been expelled upon their sixteenth birthday. The now heavily fortified settlement has hit hard times as the super mutants have turned their eyes towards it for victims to kidnap.

(Rarity 3 Explosives Vendor)

name: BOS Check Point, Potomac Bridge
description: One of the new encampments that the BOS has set up in there efforts to distribute water to local settlements, this one sits nestled in at the end of the partially collapsed Potomac Bridge.

name: Broadcast Tower KB5
description: An old world radio antenna broadcasts Morse code on a loop, Jetting from the side of the hill, a drainage pipe can be seen.

name: Broadcast Tower KT8
description: A lone broadcast tower stands as the only point of interest in the hilly area.

name: Broadcast Tower LP8
description: A massive tower looms at the top of a hill, a red light at its peak, lazily blinking.

name: Broadway Cinema
description: The last films shown in the theater still survive on the marquee and include One Wife Hold the Meatballs, Raz Bastion and the Amazons of Xarn, I Married a Maoist, and Hush Sweet Senator Hush.

name: Brotherhood Outcast Bunker
description: A once military checkpoint, it now serves as a greater Outpost for the Brotherhood Outcasts.
vendors: *Specialist Ed's Workshop* (*Specialist Ed*, Human: Rarity 4 Weapon/Armor Vendor)

name: Brotherhood Outcast Depot
description: A once military checkpoint, it now serves as a greater Outpost for the Brotherhood Outcasts.
vendors: *Specialist Johnson's Workshop* (*Specialist Ed*, Human: Rarity 3 Weapon/Armor Vendor)

name: Brotherhood Outcast Outpost
description: A number of BOS Outcasts guard an old metro entrance leading into the ruins.

name: Brotherhood Outcast Shack
description: a small shack adorned with the Outcast's sigil can be found here.

name: Brotherhood Way Station, Bethesda
description: One of the new encampments that the BOS has set up in there efforts to distribute water to local settlements, this one overlooks the ruins of Bethesda.

name: Brotherhood Way Station, Big Town
description: One of the new encampments that the BOS has set up in there efforts to distribute water to local settlements, this one sits just outside of Big Town.

name: Brotherhood Way Station, Potomac
description: One of the new encampments that the BOS has set up in there efforts to distribute water to local settlements, this one overlooks the Potomac river at a major intersection.

name: Calverton
description: Calverton itself is comprised of the shells of six destroyed houses around a three-way intersection and a large old world church. A hostage negotiation of some kind seems to be  taking place inside.

name: Canterbury Commons
description: A popular trading settlement recently founded by Ernest "Uncle" Roe and his sister Daisy as a trading center for caravan merchants in the Capital Wasteland. Recently it has become embroiled in an abnormal conflict between two “super hero” themed individuals; the AntAgonizer and "the Mechanist".

name: Canterbury Commons Red Rocket
description: A fairly regular pre-war establishment, one which specialized in coolants, fuels and salty snacks.

name: Capitol Building
description: An active warzone, the Talon Company seem to be trying to recapture it for their benefactors from the Super mutants that have maid it a base.

name: Capitol Post
description: A pre-war newspaper HQ, a fairly popular one given the number of their last issue still present.

name: Car Dealership
description: An old world car dealership with a number of vehicles still on display, now slightly weathered it still advertises selling the brand new 2077 Corvega for only $199,999.99. It apparently has been commandeered by President Eden in his efforts to re-habilitate America.

name: Cave, Bunker
description: A small cave sits abandoned amidst the hills, the sandbags at its mouth suggesting it served as a fortification at some point.

name: Cave, Drug Lab
description: A small drug lab has been constructed in the interior of the dingy cave.

name: Cave, Flooded
description: Gentle lapping echoes from the hillside cave.

name: Cave, Rubble
description: A small cave resides along the rubble of the hills.

name: Cave, Shrub Hidden
description: A naturally formed cave is barely visible through the shrubbery of the hill side. Strange noises echo out from it, lending a sense of unease to those outside.

name: Cave, Trash
description: A small cave amongst the hills has been fully filled with pre-war trash, some of the barrels having a “JB Waste Dispose” stenciled on them.

name: Charnel House
description: This farm house has been transformed for the benefit of the raiders that reside there.

name: Chaste Acres Dairy Farm
description: A small pre-war dairy farm with a destroyed barn.

name: Chevy Chase, East
description: This ruined neighborhood, much like other neighborhoods of Washington, D.C., is largely inaccessible to enter except through one of its metro stations.

name: Chevy Chase, North
description: This ruined neighborhood, much like other neighborhoods of Washington, D.C., is largely inaccessible to enter except through one of its metro stations.

name: Chryslus Building
description: Thus ruined office building proudly displays Chryslus' newest model on its face.

name: Cliffside Cavern
description: High up a cliffside switchback a gaping hole draws in air. Gunfire and the unmistakable roar of Yao-Guai can be be heard echoing from its depths.

name: Clifftop Shacks
description: This small, fortified plateau with a number of shacks on it is known for its security and welcoming community. It has recently gone silent and is likely dealing with its own problems. It is more than likely that the Supermutants have emptied the town in their attempt to make more mutants.
notable_loot: Board of Education (★Crippling★ Board, Spiked Mod)

name: Concrete treehouse
description: What appears to be a raised dwelling constructed from a collapsed overpass support.
vendors: *Hershel's Stash* (*Hershel, Human: Junk Vendor)

name: Cornucopia Fresh Groceries, Potomac Ave
description: What appears to be just one of many of its kind, a chain brand pre-war grocery.

name: Cornucopia Fresh Groceries, Riverside
description: What appears to be just one of many of its kind, a chain brand pre-war grocery.

name: Cornucopia Fresh Groceries, Seneca
description: What appears to be just one of many of its kind, a chain brand pre-war grocery.

name: Cornucopia Fresh Groceries, Takoma Park
description: What appears to be just one of many of its kind, a chain brand pre-war grocery.

name: Corvega Factory
description: A massive pre-war factory of some importance, one that created pre-war vehicles.

name: Corvega Township, East
description: What appears to be part of a company town, now ravaged by looting, war and time. This section was dedicated to unsettlingly cookie cutter houses.

name: Corvega Township, North
description: What appears to be part of a company town, now ravaged by looting, war and time. This section was dedicated towards logistics and sales.

name: Corvega Township, South
description: What appears to be part of a company town, now ravaged by looting, war and time. This section was dedicated to vehicle production.

name: Corvega Township, West
description: What appears to be part of a company town, now ravaged by looting, war and time. This section was dedicated towards the apparent, all but worship of the company leadership.

name: Crashed Nuka-Cola Truck
description: An old Nuka-Cola truck was driven into a ditch pre-war, given the apparent care that was taken.

name: Cratered Hamlet
description: The shell of a few buildings boarder a still smoldering crater.

name: Cuppa Joe, Fairfax
description: The single roomed, drive up building remains completely surrounded by a long stretching line of vehicles.

name: Cuppa Joe, Paradise Falls
description: A small pre-war coffee shop still stands here.

name: Cuppa Joe, Riverside
description: This small riverside coffee stand appears to Have had quite a bit of foot traffic, if the number of skeletons are to be taken at their unspoken word.

name: Cuppa Joe, Takoma Park
description: Two seemingly identical coffee shops sit across the street from one another, both equally disheveled.

name: Darren's Discounts
description: The building was a large discount electronic warehouse named "Darren's Discounts" before the war.

name: Deathcalw Nest, Garbage Truck
description: An overturned garbage truck seems to have been appropriated by at least one nesting Deathclaw.

name: Deathclaw Nest, Box Canyon
description: A natural funnel made of stone; its end point fosters a moldering pile of rotting debris.

name: Deathclaw Nest, Car Pile
description: A rotting pile of waste can be found under a number of detonated vehicles.

name: Deathclaw Nest, Clearing
description: In the small clearing a large nest of slowly rotting mulch has been erected.

name: Deathclaw Nest, Cliff Side
description: A rotting smell can be sampled, wafting from a cliff side.

name: Deathclaw Nest, Cornucopia Groceries
description: A once grocery store has become the home to a particularly smelly resident. Through the boarded up windows you can smell a pungent rot.

name: Deathclaw Nest, Fissure
description: Large moldering mounds rest cliff's overhang, a multitude of shells lining their bases.

name: Deathclaw Nest, Main Street
description: A number of old Onley's main street buildings have been filled with decomposing piles of rubbish. It's surprisingly quiet as only the gentle hissing of the still functional steam works disrupts the scene.

name: Deathclaw Nest, Old Cabin
description: An old cabin has been all but demolished by a Deathclaw who’s made a nest out of the once crawlspace.

name: Deathclaw Nest, Overturned Semi
description: A pile of rotting debris has been piled in the back of an overturned semi trailer.

name: Deathclaw Nest, Rocky
description: This section has a Deathclaw nest nestled amongst the cliffs.

name: Deathclaw Nest, Sewer
description: A strong stench streams from the open manhole and nearby fissure in the roadway.

name: Deathclaw Nest, Utility Building
description: In the ruins of an old utility building, a large moist mound can be smelt and seen spilling from the doorway.

name: Deathclaw Sanctuary
description: This underground grotto seems to have been almost perfectly designed to provide for its denizens.

name: Dickerson Tabernacle Chapel
description: A partially collapsed church and moldering cemetery sit here quietly.

name: Docked Boat
description: A boat sits in the river side current, held in places by its moorings.
vendors: Cpt Smitty's Catch (*Cpt Smitty*, Ghoul: Rarity 1 Food Vendor)

name: Dot's Diner, Canterbury Commons
description: An old pre-war dinner sits atop the hill, still proudly overlooking the road provided service 24 hours a day.

name: Dot's Diner, Fairfax
description: An old pre-war dinner sits atop the hill, still proudly overlooking the road provided service 24 hours a day. This one boasts a perfectly placed metro entrance.

name: Dot's Diner, Grayditch
description: An old pre-war dinner sits atop the hill, still proudly overlooking the road provided service 24 hours a day.

name: Dot's Diner, Hillside
description: An old pre-war dinner sits atop the hill, still proudly overlooking the road provided service 24 hours a day.

name: Drowned Devil's Crossing
description: A particularly collapsed bridge spans a small river.

name: Dry Sewer
description: A surprisingly dry and populated sewer system, booming shouts and rapid gunfire echo through its tunnels.

name: Dukov's Place
description: A pre-War hotel turned party pad, it happily resides near the Potomac, strangely left untouched by raiders.

name: Dunwich Building
description: A eerie silence permeates the old pre-war building, the signage on its side suggesting that it was once involved in pre-war mining.

name: Dupont Circle Station
description: While Most of the station has collapsed, it has been made of great use by its occupying raiders. A likely target of Supermutants, it still holds some pre-war security systems.

name: Dupont East
description: A section of the Dupont circle, it is composed of roadways and long dead parks.

name: Dupont North East
description: A section of the Dupont circle, it is composed of roadways and long dead parks.

name: Dupont West
description: A section of the Dupont circle, it is composed of roadways and long dead parks.

name: Early Dawn Elementary
description: The now ruined school still has posters reminders of a field trip to the Lamplight Caverns.

name: Enclave Base, National Guard Depot
description: A number of modular metal barricades and walkways have been constructed as a map to loot the nearby National Guard Depot. This camp is seemingly on Augustus Autumn's side of the civil war.

name: Enclave Camp, Chryslus Building
description: A number of modular metal barricades and walkways have been constructed to pillage the nearby auto plant. This camp is seemingly on President Eden's side of the civil war.

name: Enclave Camp, Crash Site
description: A number of modular metal barricades and walkways have been constructed as a staging post for a nearby crash site. This camp is seemingly on President Eden's side of the civil war.

name: Enclave Camp, Deathclaw Reclamation
description: A number of modular metal barricades and walkways have been constructed on the hilltop along with a number of massive metal cages. This camp is seemingly on Augustus Autumn's side of the civil war.

name: Enclave Camp, Fairfax ruins
description: A number of modular metal barricades and walkways have been constructed here along with what appears to be a meeting tent. This camp is seemingly on President Eden's side of the civil war.

name: Enclave Camp, Hilltop Outpost
description: A number of modular metal barricades and walkways have been constructed around a Verti-bird platform and coolant tanks. This camp is seemingly on Augustus Autumn's side of the civil war.

name: Enclave Camp, Old Olney
description: A number of modular metal barricades and walkways have been constructed here with a multitude of tracks leading towards the old power works. This camp is seemingly on Augustus Autumn's side of the civil war.

name: Enclave Camp, RHO
description: A number of modular metal barricades and walkways have been constructed at the crossroad to apparently test an experimental turret system. This camp is seemingly on President Eden's side of the civil war.

name: Enclave Camp, SatCom Array NW-05a

description: A number of modular metal barricades and walkways have been constructed on the roadside along with what appears to be a maze of zig-zagging ropes meant to form a que. This camp is seemingly on President Eden's side of the civil war.

name: Enclave Checkpoint, Fort Independence
description: A number of modular metal barricades and walkways have been constructed on the hilltop overlooking Fort Independence. This camp is seemingly on Augustus Autumn's side of the civil war.

name: Enclave Checkpoint, Highway
description: A number of modular metal barricades and walkways have been constructed along the roadway with a sigh indicating vaccinations. This camp is seemingly on President Eden's side of the civil war.

name: Enclave Checkpoint, Jury Street
description: A number of modular metal barricades and walkways have been constructed on the hilltop in the shadow of an old power pylon. This camp is seemingly on Augustus Autumn's side of the civil war.

name: Enclave Checkpoint, Reclining Groves
description: A military checkpoint warning of a radioactive spill still blocks the road. This camp is seemingly on President Eden's side of the civil war.

description: A number of modular metal barricades and walkways have been constructed in the roadway, seemingly set on stopping travelers. This camp is seemingly on Augustus Autumn's side of the civil war.

name: Enclave Outpost, Girdershade
description: A number of modular metal barricades and walkways have been constructed on the hilltop, an observation post most likely. This camp is seemingly on Augustus Autumn's side of the civil war.

name: Enclave Outpost, Highpoint
description: A number of modular metal barricades and walkways have been constructed on the highest hill in sight, a likely perfect position for observation. This camp is seemingly on Augustus Autumn's side of the civil war.

name: Enclave Outpost, Penn Ave (Dukov)
description: A number of modular metal barricades and walkways have been set up to "screen" passersbys. This camp is seemingly on President Eden's side of the civil war.

name: Enclave Outpost, Seward Square
description: A number of modular metal barricades and walkways have been constructed as a seeming meeting place. This camp is seemingly on President Eden's side of the civil war.

name: Enclave Outpost, Takoma Industrial
description: A number of modular metal barricades and walkways have been constructed to serve as a camp to loot the nearby Takoma plant. This camp is seemingly on Augustus Autumn's side of the civil war.

name: Enclave Outpost, Yao Guai Observation
description: A number of modular metal barricades, cages and walkways have been constructed to serve as a camp to observe the local wildlife. This camp is seemingly on President Eden's side of the civil war.

name: Enclave Reclamation Camp, Nuka-Cola Plant
description: A number of modular metal barricades and walkways have been constructed to pillage the nearby Nuka-Cola plant. This camp is seemingly on Augustus Autumn's side of the civil war.

name: Enclave Spotter Station
description: A number of modular metal barricades and walkways have been constructed around a Verti-bird platform and coolant tanks. This camp is seemingly on Augustus Autumn's side of the civil war.

name: Enclave Springvale Power Plant Outpost
description: A number of modular metal barricades and walkways have been constructed in an attempt to retain control of the power supply. This camp is seemingly on Augustus Autumn's side of the civil war.

name: Everglow National Campground
description: A pre-war campground sits abandoned amidst the burned out trees.

name: Evergreen Mills
description: The once forested hills of the area were torn away far before the end of the world leaving it a highly defensible mined out box canyon. The factory at its heart having plunder the earth for its old world operations is now the HQ of the Evergreen hills raiders. While opportunistic raiders and slavers, they do welcome travels to pursue their services, as long as they have caps to spend. Much of there business as of late has been split between supplying the slavers of the Pitt with fresh bodies and more recently, the local Supermutants.
vendors: Smiling Jack's Bar and Armory ([Smiling Jack](https://fallout.wiki/wiki/Smiling_Jack), Human: Rarity 4 Weapon/Beverage Vendor)
Madam's Brothel ([Madam](https://fallout.wiki/wiki/Madame), Human, Madam)
The Mess (Slaves, Human: Rarity 3 Food Vendor)

name: Exploding Scientist Truck
description: An old truck sitting atop the highway sits idle, a tail of smoke working its way from the cracked roll door of the trailer.

name: F. Scott Key Trail & Campground
description: A large clearing amongst the burned out trees harbors a number of pre-war campsites.

name: Faded Pomp Estates
description: A cavalcade of destroyed retirement homes line either side of the road.

name: Fairfax Raider Fiefdom
description: Originally based in Fort Independence, these raiders were displaced by the Outcasts and have now taken over the utility tunnels under the town. Loosely organized towards raiding over slaving like their fellows in Evergreen Mills and Paradise Falls. These ruthless killers only respect strength and often cannibalize their victims. While uncommon, some may barter or offer services to those who are too much trouble to fight, have something to offer and or on good terms.
notable_loot: Try Again (★Auto Stim★ Raider Power Armor chest)
vendors: *Butcher's Bin* (*Butcher*, Human: Rarity 2 Food Vendor)
*The Gun Rack* (*Ramesses*, Human: Rarity 4 Weapon Vendor)

name: Falls Church Metro
description: This station's interior is in a state of serious decay and collapse. The area is also partially irradiated and as such has had little long term occupation by normal or sensible humans.

name: Falls Church North
description: An invariable battlefield between the BOS and the monstrosities that inhabit the ruins.

name: Falls Church South
description: An invariable battlefield between the BOS and the monstrosities that inhabit the ruins.

name: Fantastique Cinema
description: After the War it fell prey to the elements, leaving only a ruined shell behind. The last films shown in the theater still survive on the marquee and include Adios Muchachos, P.S. I Hate You, The Nutty Nanny, and Destination: Anchorage.

name: Farm, Old Tractor
description: The small ruins of a roadside farm, a tractor still mid plow sits in its field.

name: Farm, Reclining Groves
description: A small farm advertising itself an "pinko free" and a proud supplier for the Mama Dolce company.

name: Farm, Roadside
description: A small roadside farm resides here, relatively un-ravaged by the war.

name: Farragut West Metro Station
description: This river side metro tunnel consists of a cover stairway that leads towards the metro system. The Metro system itself is relatively intact and a service tunnel connects to Tenleytown/Friendship station.

name: Festive Raider Camp
description: A town square with a scrap fence around it and a tree decorated with Christmas lights.

name: Five Axles Rest Stop
description: Five Semi trucks were pulled together at some point, forming a wagon circle of sorts.

name: Flipped Boat
description: An overturned boat bobs slowly in the water.

name: Flooded Metro
description: The flooded metro is located on the side of an old expressway which is littered with decrepit pre-War cars and runs under the rubble of a highway overpass. The interior of the flooded metro is a fairly long and winding maze of stairs and tunnels that connect to Mason District South at the other end.

name: Flooded Metro Raider Camp
description: The encampment is accessible via the covered bridge, it does offer access to the flooded Metro.

name: Fordham Flash Memorial Field
description: A large baseball field resides here, fenced in on all sides and with a strange placard near its entrance.

name: Fort Bannister
description: Now serving as the Talon Company HQ, it was originally a pre-war installation that was targeted directly during the great-war. This strike left the underground bunker exposed, but still intact with little long lasting damage. Willing to take payment from anyone for anything, these merciless mercenaries are well funded and could be potentially convinced to barter with active patrons.
vendors: Mess Hall (*Chef*, Protectron: Rarity 4 Food/Beverage Vendor)
Fort Bannister Arsenal (*Requisitions Officer Karl*, Human: Rarity 4 Weapon/Armor Vendor)
Vehicle Depot (*Requisitions Officer Ed*, Human: Vehicle Vendor)

name: Fort Constantine
description: This heavily fortified facility was once tasked with the launching nuclear warheads. Having successfully succeeded in doing its part in destroying the world, it still stands relatively untouched.
notable_loot: T-51b power armor (Full Set with Titanium Plating, ★Bolstering★ Helm)

name: Fort Independence
description: The Outcasts have adapted the old fort to their needs and restored much of its internal facilities, using it as a new HQ. All of the technology they gather is stored within along with their research findings. Originally belonging to the raiders of Fairfax, the Outcasts easily expropriated the facility, though it remains under near constant attack by its former residents.
vendors: *Fort Banister Canteen* (*SERVOMECH 112*, Robobrain: Rarity 3 Food/Beverage Vendor)
*The Armory* (*Munitions Dump*, Protectron: Rarity 4 Weapons Vendor)
*The Lab* (Specialist Smith, Human: Rarity 4 Medical Vendor)
Robotics Wing (*Specialist Browne*, Human: Rarity 4 Robot Vendor)
Smithy (*Specialist Rogers*, Human: Rarity 4 Armor Vendor)
npcs: [Protector Casdin](https://fallout.wiki/wiki/Protector_Casdin) (Leader of the Brotherhood of Steel Outcasts)

name: Franklin Metro
description: One of the many metro stations servicing the old world city, it was relatedly left unscathed by the war.

name: Friendship Heights
description: The large apparent complex still stands, overlooking the roadway and ruins.

name: Galaxy News Radio Plaza
description: The pre-war radio station as it did before the war, all be it more fortified than it used to be.

name: Georgetown North
description: A large neighborhood located in the ruins of DC, their long shadows loom over the once bustling metropolis.

name: Georgetown South
description: A large neighborhood located in the ruins of DC, their long shadows loom over the once bustling metropolis.

name: Georgetown West
description: A large neighborhood located in the ruins of DC, their long shadows loom over the once bustling metropolis.

name: Germantown Police HQ
description: After the great war this place was overwhelming with refugees seeking help, but it all eventually fell into chaos. It now serves as the main stomping grounds for the Supermutants of the region with any slaves and “green stuff” passing through here on its Way back to Vault 87.
vendors: Food Box (*Boilit*, Supermutant: Rarity 3 Food Vendor)
Good Smashers (*Slamb*, Super Mutant: Rarity 3 Weapon Vendor)
Best Hard Stuff (*Hammah Hands*, Super Mutant: Rarity 3 Weapon Vendor)

name: Ghost Ship
description: A small green boat casually bobs as it sits in the waterway unpowered and un anchored.

name: Ghoul Outpost
description: A small camp crafted from the remains of a ruined office building has been constructed here, loud yelling echoing from the interior.
vendors: *Thresh's Stash* (Thresh, Ghoul: Junk Trader)
*Selma's Patch-up* (Selma, Ghoul: Medical Vendor Rarity 3)

name: Girdershade
description: One of the last stops out of the western end of the Capital Wasteland, this small trading community has little to offer. Its main claim to fame is a small museum dedicated to Nuka-Cola. Most following the old world highway will stumble upon the settlement, likely contributing to its original founding.
notable_loot: The Kneecapper (★Kneecapper★ Double-Barrel Shotgun, Sawn-off mod)
vendors: Nuka-Cola Museum ([Sierra Petrovita](https://fallout.wiki/wiki/Sierra_Petrovita_(Fallout_3)))
Ronald's Shack ([Ronald Laren](https://fallout.wiki/wiki/Ronald_Laren), Human: Rarity 3 Weapon Vendor)

name: Gold Ribbon Grocers
description: What appears to be a recently occupied pre-war grocery store.

name: Grayditch
description: Before the Great War Grayditch was an affluent community, now it is what survivors could build out of the fancy rubble. Nonetheless it is, or perhaps was a small and slowly growing community, though in recent times little contact has come from there and smoke has been sighted rising from the region.

name: Greener Pastures Disposal Site
description: This massive "disposal site" was more akin to a dumping ground as it was overwhelmed by pre-war excess.

name: Grisly Diner
description: This abandoned diner is on the gentle uphill raising eastward.

name: Half Sunk Boat
description: A half sunk boat bobs lazily in the water, a number of radiation placards are attached to its sides.

name: Hallowed Moors Cemetery
description: There is a ruined cemetery beside the small decrepit chapel, smoke raising from the premises.

name: Hamilton's Hideaway
description: A large metal door sits snugly in the hillside.

name: Hank's Electrical Supply
description: A pre-war, independent electronics store, its windows still filled with upcoming sales 200 years past.

name: Hazmat disposal site L5
description: A pre-War hazardous waste repository, now home to a variety of mutated enemies.

name: Hidden Irradiated Pool
description: A massive irradiated pool formed in the crater of a still standing, albeit gutted office building.

name: Hilltop Farm Ruins
description: A hilltop farm and water tower dominate the otherwise flat area.

name: Holy Light Monastery
description: The cellar doors to an otherwise decimated home bear a rendition of a simple atom symbol.
npcs: [Mother Curie III](https://fallout.fandom.com/wiki/Curie_III "Curie III") (founder and leader of the [Apostles of the Eternal Light](https://fallout.fandom.com/wiki/Apostles_of_the_Eternal_Light))

name: Hotel
description: A once hotel adorned with regalia befitting the capital, it is now used a BOS outpost in there war against the Super Mutants.

name: Hubris Comics
description: A massive office building responsible for many of the more popular pre-war comics.

name: Illegal Barrel Dumping Site
description: An innumerable number of industrial barrels have been lazily dumped here. Almost every barrel has a "JB" embossed on its side and green sludge leaks from several.

name: Illegal Dumping Grounds
description: A number of pre-war refrigerators have been duped into a grotto along with innumerable smaller pieces of pre-war trash.

name: Illegal Dumping Site, Backfilled Mine
description: A small mine tunnel appears to have been jammed to the brim with trash.

name: Illegal Duping Sight, Cars
description: A large number of vehicles seem to have been purposely rolled into a chasm, neatly hidden from the highway.

name: Illegal Duping Sight, Playground
description: A number of police cars surrounded a still partly filled semi, though the scene appears to have been interrupted by the apocalypse.

name: Illegal Duping Sight, Sludge
description: An innumerable number of industrial barrels have been lazily dumped here. Almost every barrel has a ""JB"" embossed on its side and green sludge leaks from several.

name: Illegal Medical Waste Dump
description: A number of barrels clearly marked as containing bio-hazardous material poke out of the slowly eroding soil.

name: Internment Truck
description: Along the old Highway a large truck sticks out as the only notable feature, its trailer still attached and trailer gate still down.

name: Irradiated Metro
description: The exterior stands in the ruins of the old world, adjacent to a highway and connected to the other side of the street by a raised walkway. The tunnel system interior is slightly radioactive in some places due to it having partially collapsed.

name: Jalbert Brothers Waste Disposal
description: The waste disposal facility is an open-air dump filled with many barrels of radioactive waste, many stacked haphazardly.

name: Jefferson Memorial
description: This large round building has been seemingly co-opted as some kind of strange pumping station at no little experience. It is now the center of water distribution and soft power for the BOS.

name: Jocko's Pop & Gas Stop
description: A pre-war coolant station and soda jerk combo sit along the once highway pull off.

name: Jury Street Dinner
description: An old pre-war dinner sits atop the hill, still proudly overlooking the road provided service 24 hours a day.

name: Jury Street Red Rocket
description: A fairly regular pre-war establishment, one which specialized in coolants, fuels and salty snacks.

name: L.O.B. Enterprises
description:
L.O.B. Enterprises
L.O.B. Enterprises was a pre-War weapons manufacturer before the war. Rumors arose and subsequently spread of their activities, and L.O.B. Enterprises soon came under federal scrutiny, due to importing Chinese products from Happy Liberty Imports, a Chinese front.

name: L'Enfant Plaza
description: A large plaza that served as an open-space commuting thoroughfare before the Great War with a unique glass pyramid being its key landmark. It is now populated by a large number of super mutants.

name: La Maison Beauregard
description: An outstandingly fancy building that doubtlessly catered to outstandingly fancy individuals.

name: Lady Frumperton's Fashions
description: A pre-war clothing shop specializing in woman's apparel.

name: Lincoln Memorial
description: A massive stone figure sits beheaded atop a throne, likely a historic figure given the locations placement. It is occupied by slavers from Paradise Falls, to rob slaves of a powerful symbol.

name: Little Lamplight
description: Originally a tourist destination, this cave system has become known as a dumping ground for orphans. Apparently populated exclusively by children since it's unfortunate school trip founding, all “Mongos” are banned entry and once you've reached the ripe age of 16, you are banished from the settlement.
notable_loot: Wazer Wifle (★Violent★ Laser Gun, Standard Stock, Improved Barrel)
vendors: Spelunkers ([Eclair](https://fallout.wiki/wiki/Eclair), Human: Food and Beverage Vendor Rarity 4)
Souvenir Shop ([Knick Knack](https://fallout.wiki/wiki/Knick_Knack), Human: Junk Vendor Rarity 3)
Fist Aid Station ([Lucy](https://fallout.wiki/wiki/Lucy_(Fallout_3)), Human: Medical Vendor Rarity 3)

name: Lost Boat
description: A green boat slowly drifts in the water as it motors on in circles.

name: Lucky's
description: This pre-war store still stands relatively intact, once a vendor of odds and ends, it has been occupied by merchants from time to time and generally serves the same purpose.
vendors: *Buck's Bounty* (*Buck*, Human: Rarity 3 Food/Beverage Vendor)

name: Madame Jealle's
description: A pre-War adult bookstore, euphemistically billed on its sign as the "Reading Room for the Discreet Gentleman.

name: Majority Whip's!
description: A pre-war ice cream parlor, one apparently regularly serving once world leaders.

name: Mama Dolce's
description: Originally a pre-war front for Chinese spies and the People's Liberation Army, this business found rapid and unexpected success selling what could be generously considered food to pre-war Americans. To this day many of the workers that used printer ink and sawdust as food additives still remain within, having become ghouls. Still desiring to convert the masses to communism, they will attempt to sway wastelands towards their beliefs as long as they are not hostile.
vendors: *Passports and Diplomatic Accommodations* (*Li Min*, Ghoul: Rarity 1 Junk Vendor)
*The People's Ample Repository* (*Compliance Officer Zi*, Liberator: Rarity 4 Weapon Vendor)
*The People's Bountiful Mess Hall* (*Xiǎo Huì*, Liberator: Rarity 4 Food/Beverage Vendor)
*The People's Abundant Garments* (*Comrade Joe*, Synth: Rarity 4 Clothes Vendor)

name: Marigold Station
description: A number of ant hills and fires surround the station's entrance, its stairs are stained and scuffed with drag marks into its depths. The tunnels themselves are smokey and smell of burning refuse and flesh.
npcs: [Dr. Weston Lesko](https://fallout.fandom.com/wiki/Weston_Lesko) (He is indirectly responsible for causing the destruction of Grayditch.)
[William Brandice](https://fallout.fandom.com/wiki/William_Brandice) (an Enclave deserter who tried to save in Grayditch, his current home)

name: Mason District
description: This mainly consists of a large flooded park surrounded by buildings.

name: Mason Dixon Salvage
description: A number of smoke plums rise above what seems to have been a pre-War auto parts and salvage complex.

name: MDPL Mass Relay Station
description: What appears to be a heavily fortified power station lingers in the shadows of the still standing power lines. The exterior seems to have recently besmirched BOS markings on its side.

name: Megaton
description: Originally built by survivors attempting to enter Vault 101, its founders took shelter in a deep crater created by a still active, but un-detonated warhead. Over the past 200+ years it was built up greatly, now having a massive turbine raised gate, shanty buildings climbing the crater walls and a large scrap metal wall around the settlement.
vendors: [The Brass Lantern](https://fallout.wiki/wiki/The_Brass_Lantern "The Brass Lantern") ([Andy Stahl](https://fallout.wiki/wiki/Andy_Stahl), Human: Rarity 3 Food Vendor)
[Craterside Supply](https://fallout.wiki/wiki/Craterside_Supply "Craterside Supply") ([Moira Brown](https://fallout.wiki/wiki/Moira_Brown), Human: Rarity 3 Armor Vendor)
[Megaton Armory](https://fallout.wiki/wiki/Megaton_Armory "Megaton Armory") ([Deputy Steel](https://fallout.wiki/wiki/Deputy_Steel), Mr. Gusty: Rarity 3 Weapon Vendor)

[Moriarty's Saloon](https://fallout.wiki/wiki/Moriarty%27s_Saloon "Moriarty's Saloon") ([Gob](https://fallout.wiki/wiki/Gob), Ghoul: Rarity 4 Beverage Vendor/Brothel
[Nova](https://fallout.wiki/wiki/Nova) Prostitute)
*Walter's Shop* ([Walter](https://fallout.wiki/wiki/Walter_(Fallout_3)), Human: Rarity 3 Robot Modder)

name: Meresti Trainyard
description: This once abandoned railyard station now serves as the refuge for a group of mutants known as “The Family”. The station itself has been converted into a small village, the upper platforms being converted to a residential area and the lower platforms as a commercial and communal area.
vendors: Karl's ([Karl](https://fallout.wiki/wiki/Karl_(Fallout_3)), Human: Medical Rarity 4 Vendor, Junk Rarity 3 Vendor)

name: Metro Central
description: Metro Central was once the main D.C. Metro hub, the largest metro station in the region and likely the most frequented pre-war. Due to its strategic importance, it has been the battleground of several skirmishes between raiders the Talon Company and the feral ghouls. The aftermath of these skirmishes have left several members' corpses of said factions scattered all around the station, with two barricades still left standing.

name: Metro Sink Hole
description: A massive sinkhole has opened in the earth, proving potentially convenient access to the metro system. Likely started by an untouched and still running burst water main, the last 200 years has formed a hole large enough to connect to a nearby, now partly flooded cave system that it has formed and the metro that it has connected to.

name: Metro Station, Jury Street
description: This once lively neighborhood escaped the immediate fallout of the war, but not its aftermath. The now despoiled carcass of a neighborhood now resembled a warzone. A covered stairway leads down into the metro tunnels, they survived relatively unscathed, but are likely occupied.

name: Metro Station, Northwest Seneca
description: While still accessible from ground level the interior of the metro has suffered great damage. This collapsed metro station has an irradiated sewer tunnel that leads to Meresti service tunnel and eventually Meresti Metro station. A strong chemical small most would associate with drugs eliminate from within.
npcs: Murphy (A ghoul scientist distilling Ultrajet with Sugar Bombs, a highly guarded recipe)
Barret (The ghoul bodyguard and assistant of Murphy)

name: Military Checkpoint, Back Road
description: A number of vehicles reside on the side of thus back road, a line of still bound skeletons are piled in a nearby ditch.

name: Military Checkpoint, Communist Screening
description: A pre-war checkpoint set up to screen for the new flu and "anti-Americanism" according to the postings.

name: Military Checkpoint, Crossroads
description: A military checkpoint that seems to have been blown through by a particularly desperate individual.

name: Military Checkpoint, Enlist! billboard
description: A large "Enlist!" billboard overlooks a pre-war checkpoint that entirely blocks the roadway.

name: Military Checkpoint, Five Axles's
description: A Pre-war Checkpoint still resides here, blocking half the roadway and with multiple postings indicating its purpose was to “screen for communists” in the public.

name: Military Checkpoint, Fort Constantine
description: A pre-war checkpoint still stands here, blocking the road entirely with a truck. A small tent and multiple barriers still remain along with another truck that was pulled to the shoulder.

name: Military Checkpoint, Hillside
description: A pre-war checkpoint leading towards the highway, it seems to have been screening for "The New Plague" according to the posters.

name: Military Checkpoint, Olney
description: An old world checkpoint still remains here, screening for individuals sick with the "new flu" according to the signs.

name: Military Checkpoint, Reclining Groves
description: A military checkpoint warning of a radioactive spill still blocks the road.

name: Military Checkpoint, Smith Casey's
description: A pre-war checkpoint still lingers here, the roadway half blocked by a still parked truck.

name: Military Checkpoint, Vault Billboard
description: A number of barricades and a military truck obstruct the bridge, a gleeful vault boy overlooking it all from his billboard.

name: Minefield
description: An old-world neighborhood seems to have been made into an actual minefield and has been this way for long enough to have given it the name.

name: Mirelurk Nest, Fountain
description: A large water feature serves as a spawning ground for disgusting creatures.

name: Mirelurk Nest, Marsh
description: A large nest has been constructed in the strip of marshland.

name: Mirelurk Nest, Muddy
description: The muddy banks harbor a number of flotsam nests.

name: Mirelurk Nest, Old Boat
description: Something appears to be nesting in an old boat.

name: Mirelurk Nest, Over Turned Van
description: An overturned van has been recently colonized.

name: Mirelurk Nest, Roadway
description: A Mirelurk nest has been constructed in the shadow of the roadway’s retaining wall.

name: Mirelurk Nest, Tidal Basin
description: A large nest has been built up on the Tidal Basin's shore. They seem to be doing poorly with the now treated waters.

name: Mobile Base Crawler
description: The current HQ of Colonel Autumn's Reformist faction of the Enclave, having been recently relocated from the nearby Adams Airforce Base, was pushed to its limits. The heavily armed and armored platform acts as a sort of mobile bunker and is currently hooked into Ole Olney's power supplies via power stations as its reactor undergoes repairs.
notable_loot: Colonel Autumn's laser pistol (★Deadeye★ laser pistol)
Deals 100 ▣ Vicious, Piercing, Breaking, Blast Damage to a target within Sight
Requires Raven Rock Uplink to fire
Destroys any location it is fired on

name: Mole rat Den, Hilltop
description: A human sized hole resides in the side of the hill, fresh dirt having spilled from its mouth recently.

name: Mole Rat Den, Hollow Hill
description: A small system of tunnels likely undermining the entire hill.

name: Mole Rat Den, Metro Burrow
description: A number of holes have been dug into the small hill, each with fresh soil at their mouths, a number of ruined metro protectrons are mixed in.

name: Mole Rat Den, River Front
description: A number of holes have been dug into the small hill, each with fresh mud oozing from their mouths.

name: Mole Rat Den, Roadway
description: A small system of tunnels likely undermining the roadway can be found here.

name: Mole Rat Den, Windy
description: A faint wind can be felt at many of the tunnel mouths, suggesting a connection to a larger system, perhaps the old metro.

name: Mole Rat Metro Den
description: The endlessly toiling mole rats seemed to have tunneled into the underground metro system.

name: Mole Rat Race Track
description: What appears to be a raider planned betting operation constructed from an old highway segment.

name: Monorail Train Wreckage
description: The remains of the long ago crash of the once impressive regional monorail.

name: Montgomery County Reservoir
description: This sprawling water purification plant has long since ceased operation.

name: Moonbeam Outdoor Cinema
description: Not much beyond a dirt field and a large screen, a number of vehicles does suggest that it was at least a simi popular destination.

name: Mount Mabel Campground
description: A scant few camper trailers and long abandoned vehicles mingle themselves with the now charred forest.

name: Museum Authority Building
description: Appearing as a relatively standard office building, it seemingly directed its siblings.

name: Museum Of Technology
description: A grand museum, home to many iconic exhibits, vehicles, and attractions that educated and entertained tourists before the Great War.

name: Musty Caverns
description: A small mound of earth and refuse resides in a small clearing.

name: National Archives
description: Pre-war flags still hang from the face of this pillared building. Placards on its face outline its proud responsibility of guarding the nation's most important documents.

name: National Guard Depot
description: A large, partially collapsed military complex shelters a locked bunker door. The bunker door seems to have no way to pick or crack the lock and instead requires a code of some kind to enter.

name: Navy Yard–Ballpark
description: An old world baseball park looms over a large parking lot, its towering walls and limited entrances making a kind of fortress, though it may have symbolic value for those obsessed with the old world.

name: Nifty Thrifty's
description: A small mom and pop thrift store filled with "antiques" from the old world.

name: Nuka-Cola Plant
description: The large, three-story factory proudly displays Nuka-Cola on its siding.

name: Oaisis
notable_loot: Linden's Outcast power armor (★Powered★ T51 Power Armor Chest with Set)

*The Weaving Patch* ([Branchtender Maple](https://fallout.wiki/wiki/Branchtender_Maple), Human: Rarity 4 Clothes Vendor)

name: Old Olney Red Rocket
description: A fairly regular pre-war establishment, one which specialized in coolants, fuels and salty snacks.

name: Old Olney Sewers
description: The still humming heart of Old Olney's steam works and power conduits, most that go in seem to never come out.

name: Olney Metro
description: This strange round about station served as the end of the line for the old world metro system. It now apparently serves as a host to some creature's particularly pungent nest.

name: Olney Powerworks
description: Old Olney's massive power plant still hums with life and activity, still supplying much of the region with power through its wavering infrastructure.

name: Our Lady Hospital
description: The region's largest hospital, a broadcasting antenna has fallen from the hospital onto the Statesman Hotel.

name: Paradise Falls
description: A pre-war shopping center turned fortified slaver den, all overlooked by an ice cream welding giant in suspenders of plaid. Now the HQ for the Capital Wasteland's slavers, it sees great wealth and suffering pass through. Those willing to behave may even peruse the market or take advantage of its many services.

name: Paradise Falls Red Rocket
description: A fairly regular pre-war establishment, one which specialized in coolants, fuels and salty snacks.

name: Patriotic Picnic Area
description: A small picturesque picnic area sits here, seemingly un bothered by the end of the world.

name: Pennsylvania Avenue, South
description: The large plaza still stands, despite proximity to such high value targets. It is currently a battlefield hosting BOS, Supermutants, Talon Company and Enclave forces, many finding strange bedfellows as the war has waged far past any sensible duration and has spiraled out of control.

name: Pennsylvania Avenue, West
description: The large plaza still stands, despite proximity to such high value targets. It is currently a battlefield hosting BOS, Supermutants, Talon Company and Enclave forces, many finding strange bedfellows as the war has waged far past any sensible duration and has spiraled out of control.

name: Pirate Pely
description: There are a few waterlogged boats located outside, though they are unusable. The shop dealt with "Rentals, Worms, Ice Cream and Talking Parrots" according to the sigh.

name: Platz Station
description: Another of the multitude of metro entrances, it like most consists of a cover stairway. On the brink of collapse, it wouldn't take much to collapse what remains of the interior.

name: Power Station, MDPL-05
description: A number of power lines stretch towards the still humming and fenced in facility.

name: Power Station, MDPL-11
description: A loudly humming power station and utility building resides near the roadway.

name: Power Station, MDPL-12
description: A humming power yard and utility building with a number of vehicles parked around it.

name: Power Station, MDPL-13
description: A large derelict power plant prominently featuring three exhaust chimneys.

name: Power Station, MDPL-14
description: A number of power lines stretch towards the still humming and fenced in facility.

name: Power Station, MDPL-15
description: A small utility road leads towards a utility shed and fenced off relays.

name: Power Station, MDPL-16
description: This station consists of transformers that are secured by a gate and fences. The power substation is located just outside the fenced area.

name: Power Station, MDPL-21
description: A small utility shed overlooks its partially detonated power yard.

name: Power Station, MDPL-24
description: A small trail leads to this power yard and unremarkable utility shed.

name: Power Station, VAPL-58
description: The entirely fenced off power sub station has a larger than average utility building.

name: Power Station, VAPL-66
description: This roadside power station still hums with power behind its fencing, its small utility building sits adjacent as well.

name: Power Station, VAPL-82
description: Beyond the inordinate amount of blood, this power station and utility shed remain untouched. A large BOS Outcast Symbol has been painted on the station's door.
vendors: *Specialist Victoria's Workshop* (*Specialist Victoria, Human: Rarity 4 Weapon/Armor Vendor)

name: Power Station, VAPL-83
description: This small utility shed and power yard has slowly flooded, a number of rotting corpses surrounding the water.

name: Power Station, VAPL-84
description: A fenced-in power station with a tractor-trailer next to it.

name: Pylon Shack
description: A number of walls has been constructed around a pylon's base.

name: Radiation King
description: An old-world appliance center advertising the best deals in town, a faint glow radiating from inside.
vendors: *Duck Tape Darrel's* (*Duck Tape Darrel*, Human: Weapon Modifier/Junk Vendor)

name: Radio Tower
description: Placed upon a particularly high hill, this singular metal tower still stands.

name: Radscorpion Burrow
description: This naturally occurring crevice seems to have been occupied.

name: Radscorpion Burrow, Metro
description: A large burrowing creature seems to have punched its way into the metro line.

name: Radscorpion Nest, Boulder Side
description: A small nest peaks out from beneath a boulder.

name: Radscorpion Nest, Dead Tree
description: Under the roots of a long dead tree, a small nest has been built.

name: Radscorpion Nest, Deathclaw Bones
description: A small nest has been built from the remains of a massive Deathclaw.

name: Radscorpion Nest, Gravel Pit
description: Amongst the burnt out trees and scorched boulders, a Radscorpion Nest den is surrounded by flotsam.

name: Radscorpion Nest, Junk Pile
description: A large Radscorpion nest sits amongst the hills, having been constructed from what appears to be junk.

name: Radscorpion Nest, Rocky
description: Amongst the burnt out trees and scorched boulders, a Radscorpion Nest den is surrounded by flotsam.

name: Radscorpion Nest, Shrubbery
description: A nest has been dug here, barley visible through the shrubbery.

name: Raider Biker Camp
description: A number of bikes dot the macabre raider camp nestled on an old hiking trail.

name: Raider Camp, Cherry Bomb Billboard
description: A billboard advertising Chryslus' Cherry Bomb hides a raiders camp, one built to overlook the roadway.

name: Raider Camp, Dead End
description: Nestled at the end of a long wrong turn, many salvaged vehicles reside just out of sight.

name: Raider Camp, Fork
description: Poorly hidden in the roads fork, a raider camp waits for wanderers.

name: Raider Camp, Hillside
description: Hidden behind boulders and overlooking the roadway below, this raider camp’s most notable facet is its innumerable bones.

name: Raider Camp, Monorail
description: A raider camp sits nestled in the rocky cliffs around a small cage affixed with binoculars, all overlooking the roadway.

name: Raider Camp, Nuka-Cola Billboard
description: A raider camp has been constructed behind an old Nuka-Cola billboard, one prominently featuring a smiling boy. One of his teeth has been shot out, allowing for observation.

name: Raider Camp, Water Tower
description: A heavily barricaded raider camp built in a water tower looms over the otherwise treacherous area.

name: Raider Canal
description: A small raider camp had been erected to overlook the waterway.

name: Raider Encampment, Freeway
description: Built atop the half collapsed overpass allows them security and a greater view of the other roadways.

name: Raider Salvage Camp
description: Drag marks lead from a nearby roadway back to a number of shoddily made structures

name: Raider Shack, Overlook
description: This area is waterlogged and spongy, its only notable feature being a roadway that cuts through part of it.

name: Raider Shacks, Riverside
description: The dock is comprised of a boat and a small pier, accompanied by two rusted metal structures and an outhouse.

name: Raider Shop
description: A shop seemingly meant to cater to raiders is tucked away in the ruins here.

name: Raider Wharf
description: An old pre-war wharf now plays host to a number of river based raiders.

name: Raider Wreckage Fortifications
description: A roadside fortress constructed from wreckage lingers along the hill side.

name: Ranger Compound
description: A clover emblem with crossed swords has been dobbed on the side of a well fortified building.

name: Reclining Groves Resort Homes
description: Reclining Groves consists of seven ruined houses and a small playground on the north side of a stretch of paved road running east to west.

name: Red Racer Factory
description: A massive tricycle factory with a large picture of one proudly worn towards is apex.
notable_loot: [The Surgeon's lab coat](https://fallout.fandom.com/wiki/The_Surgeon%27s_lab_coat "The Surgeon's lab coat") (★Cloaking★ Lab Coat)

name: Red Speedboat
description: A read speedboat meanders freely in the water, half sunk.

name: Refuge Tent
description: What appears to have been an attempt by those who survived after the war to aid their fellow victims.

name: Regulator HQ
description: More of a meeting place for do-gooders and law enforcing types, this large farmhouse serves as the current meeting place for the Regulators. Those desperate enough to seek justice or those looking to collect bounties on their behalf usually arrive here. Beyond that a small farm has been erected, likely due to the relative security its reputation provides, at least against ne'er-do-wells.
notable_loot: Long Hand of the Law (★Powerful★ Ranger Sequoia)

*Rojo's* (*Clint*, Human: Rarity 3 Armor Vendor)

name: Relay Tower KX-B8-11
description: The tower stands about 40 feet in height and is surrounded by a fence. The signal repeats a message from Bob Andersteen that says he has taken shelter in a nearby drainage culvert with his wife and his son.

name: Republic of Dave
description: A small farming settlement in the far northeast of the Capital Wasteland, that is considered by its close-knit inhabitants to be a sovereign nation-state. In earlier years it was known as the Kingdom of Tom and Billsylvania before being taken over by its current ruler, Dave, who subsequently allowed voting, and thus, it became a republic.

name: Riverboat Landing (Point Lookout)
description: An old riverboat called the "Duchess Gambit" resides at the end of a dock, smoke still poring from its stacks.
vendors: Tobar's Goods ([Tobar](https://fallout.fandom.com/wiki/Tobar "Tobar"), Human: Junk Vendor)

name: Rivet City
description: The once pre-war aircraft carrier now serves as one of the safest and oldest settlements in the Capital Wasteland. Having been beach soon after the world ended, it has remained in place ever since and hosted an entire community within its guts. Its reactor remains the envy of the Brotherhood of Steel and allowed for the original investment in Project Purity.
notable_loot: A3-21's plasma rifle (★Powerful★ Plasma Pistole, Stock Mod)

name: Roach King's Throne
description: A lone rocket shaped throne sits atop piles of garbage.

name: Road Side Spill
description: A number of toxic barrels have spilled from a crashed semi and its trailer, having found their way into a small stream.

name: RobCo Facility
description: This pre-war office building advertises itself as a place of robotic innovation.

name: Rock Creek Caverns
description: The caverns are composed of a large section of metro tunnel/cavern that are inhabited by Mirelurks, the becoming connected to o e another at some point in the last 200 years.

name: Rockbreaker's Last Gas
description: A small coolant station resides along the side of the old road.

name: Rockland Car Tunnel
description: Carved from the mountain is a pre-war vehicle tunnel. The main entrance is collapsed, the tunnel is entered through a door built into a wall on the side. There are several irradiated pools outside of the gate.

name: Rockopolis
description: A rumored to be hidden, subterranean kingdom led by its isolationist leader, King Crag. It now offers shelter for a variety of outcasts that would be otherwise turned away by the wider world. Recent rumors and boasts however, say that it was cleared out to a man by the raiders of Evergreen Mills.
vendors: *Blood from the Stone* ([Argyle](https://fallout.fandom.com/wiki/Argyle), Ghoul: Rarity 5 Beverage vendor)

*Gabby's Passports and Diplomatic Accommodations* (*Gabby*, Robobrain: Rarity 1 Junk Vendor)

name: Roosevelt Academy
description: Consisting of three destroyed towers overlooking the court yard, it appears to have been a place of learning.

name: Ruined Farmhouse
description: A small hilltop pre-war farmhouse overlooks the ravaged lands.

name: Sander's Gambit
description: Sander’s party founded this settlement after a falling out with fellow ghouls and being rejected by Tenpenny Tower. Sanders' group of ghouls wanted to establish a new settlement away from the bigotry of the wasteland in Old Olney. The overwhelming abundance of Deathclaws in the area was seemingly a blessing as the ruins have been left relatively untouched and raider free and has allowed them to make a home of the Old Olney underground. This security however comes with great risk as it would take little more than an accident for it to be turned inwards.
difficulty: Simple or Very Hard on complication
vendors: *Badger's Bag* ([Badger](https://fallout.fandom.com/wiki/Badger_(Broken_Steel)), Ghoul: Weapons Vendor Rarity 3, Rarity 4 Explosives)

name: SatCom Array NN-03d
description: Composed of 3 satellite peaked towers built into the hillside, strangely enough they are pointed entirely vertically.

name: SatCom Array NW-05a
description: The lone satellite tower stands tall amidst the hills, its dish pointed directly skywards.
notable_loot: Deals 100 ▣ Vicious, Piercing, Breaking, Blast Damage to a target within Sight
Requires Raven Rock Uplink to fire
Destroys any location it is fired on

name: SatCom Array NW-07c
description: A military checkpoint guards an eroded path towards a strangely upturned satellite array and its decapitated sibling tower.

name: Scavenger Ruins
description: A blown-out house now serves as a makeshift storage space for a scavenger’s haul.

name: Scavenger's Bridge
description: A small fortification constructed on the covered overpass, usually housing a scavenger, giving it the name.
vendors: *Big's Big Ones* (*Bigs*, Ghoul: Rarity 3 Weapon Vendor, Rarity 4 Big Guns)

name: Scavenger's Jetty
description: A dock which contains the home of a scavenger. This makeshift home consists of an upside down boat leaning against a tree with a bed and a footlocker under the boat.
vendors: *Today's Catch* (*Fisherman James*, Human: Rarity 2 Food Vendor)

name: Scavenger's Shack
description: A small, partly destroyed Scavenger's shack.

name: Scrap Yard
description: A multitude of vehicles are stacked into towering walls, all kept behind a flimsy fence line.

name: Seward Square Metro
description: The metro itself is in relatively good condition, its interior being used heavily after the war has left it in some disrepair. The exterior is currently a battlefield between Talon Company mercs and super mutants over the Capitol Building has spilled out to this are. To the east near the subway station a number of signs point towards "Reilly's Rangers" while occasional Enclave Vertibirds drop robotic forces into the fray and offer air support.

name: Seward Square, North
description: The sprawling remains of yet more residential streets.

name: Seward Square, South East
description: The sprawling remains of yet more residential streets.

name: Sewer Waystation
description: This old sewer waystation seems to have been connected to the metro systems pre-war, likely for ease of civil access.

name: Shack Town
description: The village is a mishmash of rusted shacks and derelict vehicles while the southernmost edge of the village is protected by a steep cliff. Its inhabitants happily serve as a way station and hub of trade. It has abruptly gone quiet in recent times however, but that isn't unprecedented.

name: Shalebridge Hill
description: A large mound of trash, dirt and fungus protrude from the top of a hill. It seems to be inhabited by ants best described as forages who are being attacked by another colony best described as invaders.

name: Shalebridge Tunnel
description: A wide mouthed dirt mound containing bones and refuse can be found on the top of a hill. It seems to be inhabited by ants best described invaders, they seem to be actively raiding a nearby population of ants best described as foragers.

name: Shallow Graves
description: One of hastily dug graves appears to have accidentally penetrated the metro system.

name: Shelter
description: What appear to be one of the very few publicly available bomb shelter, the entrance is a door underneath an intact bridge.
vendors: *Fix-It's* (*Fix-It, Robobrain: Rarity 5 Medical Vendor)

name: Sink Hole
description: A massive sinkhole has naturally opened up.

name: Sinking Boat
description: A half sunk boat bobs lazily in the water, large bullet holes suggesting it being a recent fate.

name: Small ranch
description: This small ranch style home is seemingly the only one still in some kind of decent shape, the faint glow of lights from the interior even suggests that it may be populated.

name: Smith Casey's Garage
description: An old auto shop and coolant station resides here, relatively untouched by the apocalypse.

name: Sniper Shack
description: Atop the highest hill in the immediate area, a small shack has been constructed.

name: Springvale Red Rocket
description: A fairly regular pre-war establishment, one which specialized in coolants, fuels and salty snacks.

name: Springvale Ruins
description: The once picturesque small American town now sits abandoned and in ruins.

name: Springvale School
description: An old world elementary school, still standing and likely occupied. A group of raiders inhabit it with a plan to get into Vault 101 in the works.

name: Statesmen Hotel
description: A hotel given its namesake by its clientele, a broadcast tower now connects it to Our Lady of Hope Hospital. What appears to have been a major battle was waged on its roof.

name: Super Mutant Bunker
description: The Brotherhood clearly lost control of this bunker dug into the earth of the Mall some time ago.

name: Super Mutant Camp, Barrel Camp
description: A Super Mutant camp has been crudely constructed along the roadway, it seems to have an abnormal number of empty, human sized cages and empty barrels.

name: Super Mutant Camp, Cross Roads
description: A number of stacked vehicles and trash surround a number of human sized cages.

name: Super Mutant Camp, Empty Barrels
description: A large super mutant camp resides in the roadway clearing, a number of emptied, crushed barrels laying around randomly.

name: Super Mutant Camp, Hung Cages
description: A number of human sized cages and garbage alike hang from the ruins.

name: Super Mutant Camp, Riverside
description: This riverside Super Mutant camp seems to be predominantly based around the construction of human sized cages from old car scraps.

name: Super Mutant Camp, Underway
description: A super mutant camp resides along the roadway, multiple gore bags and human sized cages hanging within.

name: Super Mutant Camp, Vault-Tec Junk
description: This super mutant camp is littered with all sorts of vault tech branded items, most smashed apart.

name: Super Mutant Camp, Weapon Smith
description:
A simple camp seemingly dedicated to punching nails in boards and wrapping chains around baseball bats.


"**Overseer Information**
--

name: Super Mutant Gore Camp
description: A number of human sized cages and hanging gore bags surrounding on old sealed metro access door that says "pull" on its face.

name: Super Mutant Roof Bridge Camp
description: A number of pre-war apartments have been bridged with shoddy construction.

name: Super-Duper Mart
description: An old-world super store still mocks the residents of the wastelands with its promised abundance.

name: Supermutant Camp, Barbecue
description: A number of human sized cages have been constructed here, all hanging along a long barbecue pit.

name: Supermutant Camp, Forge
description: What appears to be a rudimentary armor production line preoccupies the camp.

name: Supermutant Camp, Vault-Tech Collection
description: This Supper mutant camp seems to have been a collection point for Vault-Tec merchandise.

name: Supermutant Camp, Vehicle Fort
description: A large stack of vehicles has been pilled into a makeshift fort in the middle of the intersection.

name: Supermutant Raiding Camp
description: A number of human sized cages and garbage alike hang from the ruins.

name: Supreme Court
description: This place once represented the communal efforts of the commonwealths to vie over one another in attempt to strengthen America's future. Clearly something went very wrong in that process as despite, or perhaps because of their efforts the opposite outcome clearly occurred. Strangely enough a number of robots are repairing the old structure at the behest of the current president.

name: Takoma Industrial
description: A large factory complex that once manufactured Abraxo cleaner is currently at the center of a war between the Talon Company and Supermutants.

name: Takoma Motor Service and Repair
description: A small, independent repair garage.

name: Takoma Park
description: This area is notable for its small assortment of mom and pop stores along with the heavy embedded Talon Company in the area.

name: Talon Company Camp, Ballpark Parking Lot
Talon Company Camp, Mutant Mounds
description: Several floors of a roadside building have been occupied by the Talon Company, a number of dead Super mutant corpses pilled in heaps at its base.

name: Talon Company Camp, National Guard Depot
description: A large Talon Company camp has been tasked with guarding the area.

name: Talon Company Camp, Vehicle Fort
description: A heavily guarded Talon Company camp has been constructed out of a number of vehicles and ruins.

name: Talon Company Kill Team Camp
description: Another of the Talon companies forward operating posts, one seeming set on killing anything that moves.

name: Talon Company Reclamation Camp
description: This large Talon Company camp has been tasked with clearing out the old world capital building.

name: Talon Company Recon Camp
description: A Talon recon camp has been constructed out of concrete and ruins.

name: Talon Encampment, Fairfax
description: An old post office has been heavily fortified by its current inhabitants.

name: Talon Forward Operating Base Alpha
description: What appears to be a staging ground for an ongoing military operation has been constructed in this old industrial building.

name: Talon Forward Operating Base Beta
description: What appears to be a staging ground for an ongoing military operation has been constructed in this old industrial building.

name: Temple of the Union
description: The Temple of the Union is a small compound in the remains of a derelict building that serves as the headquarters of the Abolitionists, a group of escaped slaves who wish to create a haven to protect and inspire all runaway slaves. A shrine of sorts has been erected around the old world god of freedom Abraham Lincoln, as his statue's head resides at its center, although it is unclear how it came to be here.
vendors: [Alejandra Torres](https://fallout.wiki/wiki/Alejandra_Torres "Alejandra Torres") (Rarity 2 Small guns and Armor Modder)

name: Tenpenny Tower
description: This once pre-war resort for the wealthy and powerful has been fortified and preserved fairly well over the years. It now serves as one of the safest, cleanest and all together most desirable places in the capital wastelands to live. Tenpenny Tower had become a private and elitist residential and commercial building owned by Allistair Tenpenny, an entrepreneur from England who only permits the well-to-do or wealthy to reside there.

description: A small municipal utility door leads to a long descending stairwell.

name: The Citadel
description: The pre-war Pentagon is now the acting HQ for the Brotherhood of Steel. After the Scourging of the Pitt and arrival to DC, they renovated and occupied the ruins. The Citadel has now become unassailable by almost any factions. The Brotherhood now directs its forces against the Super Mutant hoards and newly its water distribution caravans.

name: The Overlook Drive-In
description: This pre-war drive in seems to have been one of the nicer ones, having its lot particularly constructed.

name: The Raven Rock Bunker
description: Now serving as the headquarters for President Eden and Purists faction of the Enclave, its exterior is otherwise featureless. A long since detonated parking lot sits filled to capacity, a small path leading to a massive metal door sunken into concrete and stone lays beyond.

name: The Silver Lining Drive-In
description: The pre-war drive in now sits silent, its few early attendees still in there vehicles.

name: Toxic Waist Dump Sight B42
description: A riven section of cliffs glows faintly from leaking barrels of toxic waste, casting strange light over the pre-war trash.

name: Train Tunnel (To the Pitt)
description: This once train tunnel was converted into a makeshift camp so slavers can periodically sell slaves to the Pitt raiders. A few shacks and number of overturned boxcars have been retrofitted to hold their chattel. The Absolut darkness of the long tunnel houses little more than an old hand cart.
npcs: [Ramsey](https://fallout.fandom.com/wiki/Ramsey) (A slaver from Paradise Falls oversees the operation on this side of the tunnel)
[Prosper](https://fallout.fandom.com/wiki/Prosper) (A slave who's knowledgeable of the Pitt and his unfortunate circumstance)

name: Underworld
description: A large stairwell leads from the Mall to the once Museum of History has been occupied and made a settlement by a number of none feral, ostracized ghouls. The settlement of Underworld was founded circa 2230 out of the necessity for ghouls to live their lives in relative peace. They are wary of strangers, but will extend a civil welcome to all visitors so long as they behave themselves. The town gets its name from a special exhibit of the Museum of History that was being displayed there in late October 2077, showcasing the various cultural interpretations of the afterlife held by different civilizations throughout history.

name: Vault 101
description: One of the few pre-war vaults built before the war, 101 only recently came into broader recognition as its Lone Wander activated Project Purity prior to their death. Historically It has only ever been rumored to have opened twice, but some have recently reported Enclave forces attempting to access the great vault door, seemingly with little success.
