name: Vault 106
description: Inside a small canyon and destroyed fence, a door sits nestled in the cliffside.

name: Vault 108
description: Across from a small pond, a doorway looms in the nearby rock face.

name: Vault 87
description: This once Vault now serves as the birthplace of most of the Supermutants in DC, if not all of them. Tyrannically lead by the once gentile Fawkes, he was driven mad after the Lone Wanderer left him to his fate. He now has embraced the cruelty of his brethren to a point where he leads unchallenged. Protected by both isolation and impassible radiation, the mutants of Vault 87 hoard their pilfered gear and and plan there search for "green stuff".
vendors: *The Big Pot* (*Overlord Stew*, Super Mutant: Food Vendor Rarity 2)
*Pain Pile* (*Overlord Smash*, Super Mutant: Melee Weapon Vendor Rarity 4)
Loud Room (Overlord Slab, Super Mutant: Armor Vendor Rarity 4)

name: Vault 92
description: A small door has been built into the side of an earthen fissure.

name: Vault-Tec HQ
description: A massive office building surrounded by Supermutants and proudly bearing the logo of Vault-Tec.

name: Vernon Square Station
description: One of the few above ground metro stops, it is further individualized by the massive open air glass roof. The station itself is highly built up with shops crowding the west, north, and southern sides of the station. The interior of the station is relatively intact, though it has been recently occupied by super mutants

name: VSS Facility (Operation Anchorage)
description: A number of heavily armored BOS Outcasts guard an old lift to what appears to be a once under-constructed skyscraper's basement.
notable_loot: Winterized T-51b power armor (Full set Winterized Coating, ★Cryogenic★ Chest)
vendors: [Specialist Olin](https://fallout.fandom.com/wiki/Olin) (Rarity 4 Weapon and Armor modifier)

name: Warrington Station
description: This metro station resides in an open area within eye sight of Tenpenny tower and is relatively unblemished from the war. The interior itself seems to have been a makeshift neighborhood for a number of now absent settlers. A painted sign pointing westward directs readers towards the attached trainyard saying "The Revolution Starts here" in fresh paint.

name: Warrington Trainyard
description: The old trainyard and service station at the tunnel's mouth leads to the partially ruined and fortified subway system. The interior is currently populated by ghouls who have constructed a series of fences and barricades to keep their feral companions contained until needed and attackers out.
notable_loot: Ghoul Mask (★Lucky★ Gas Mask, Ghouls also treat you as a fellow ghoul)
npcs: [Roy Phillips](https://fallout.fandom.com/wiki/Roy_Phillips) (A local ghoul who would like to live in Tenpenny Tower, but was denied access due to bigotry.)
[Michael Masters](https://fallout.fandom.com/wiki/Michael_Masters) (Prior to the war, Michael was a renowned and electronic and biological engineer who had a focus in human mutation experiments.)

[Bessie Lynn](https://fallout.fandom.com/wiki/Bessie_Lynn) (A now timid and nervous woman who consistently defers to her boyfriend Roy Phillips in all matters, stemming from her self-consciousness at having become a ghoul.)

name: Washington Monument
description: This white obelisk of the old world still points to the sky, though it has been adorned with a number of small satellite dishes.
notable_loot: Three Dog's Headwear (★Sentinel’s★ Hood or Cowl)
The 'Fight' in the 'Good' (★Lucky★ Light Machine Gun)

name: Wastelander Camp, Highway Shaded
description: A small Wastelander camp has been constructed in the shadow of the roadway.
vendors: Penny's Neat Rocks (*Penny*, Human: Junk Vendor)

name: Wastelander Camp, Lone Tree
description: A small camp has been constructed in the open field under the sole charcoal tree.

name: Wastelander Camp, Metro Maintenance
description: A Wasteland camp constructed in a metro maintenance tunnel.

name: Wastelander Camp, Rocky
description: A small Wastelander camp constructed from hides, trash and old wood rests in a clearing.

name: Wastelander Camp, School Bus
description: A small camp has been constructed in a crashed school bus.

name: Wastelander Camp, Semi Truck
description: A small camp crafted from a half opened and still hitched semi.
vendors: Tucker's Trailer (*Tucker the Trucker*, Ghoul: Utility Item Vendor)

name: Wastelander Camp, Water Front
description: A small Wastelander's camp has been constructed along the water front.

name: Wastelander Lake Hideout
description: what appears to have been a once fishing hole seems to have become a home to someone at some time.

name: Wastelander Park Camp
description: A camp has been constructed in a small pre-war park.

name: Waterfall Mirelurk Nest
description: The mist of a nearby waterfall bathes a Mirelurk nest, one has been constructed on the shore line out of flotsam.

name: Watering Hole
description: An old-world secret, this naturally occurring spring is now less wholesome due to radioactive fallout.

name: Wet Willy's Water Works
description: A small shack stands as the sole feature of the otherwise simple camp. The shack has been erected to shelter a water purification still.

name: Wheaton Armory
description: This national guard depot consists of an underground bunker and a bombed-out office building across from it.

name: White House
description: The once capital of the US is now nothing more than an irradiated crater. One can only hope that those responsible for bringing about the end of the world where present at its destination.

name: White House Plaza
description: Much like the once capital of the US, it now nothing more than an irradiated crater. This area appear to have been guilt adjacent to the White House for social gatherings and press conferences during good weather.

name: Wilhelm's Wharf
description: A small dock and trading destination along the waterway.

name: Willy's Grocer
description: A small, independent, pre-war grocery and coolant station.

name: WKML Broadcast Station
description: Three antenna towers and a utility shed reside at the end of a utility road.

name: Yao Guai Den, Cliff Side
description: A den of some kind has been made out of a naturally occurring cave.

name: Yao Guai Den, Old Van
description: An innumerable number of bones and pre-war food wrappings surround an altogether destroyed camper van.

name: Yao Guai Den, Prospecting Tunnel
description: A den of some kind has been made from an old prospecting tunnel.

name: Yao Guai Den, Rocky
description: A naturally formed rockfall has created a shelter large enough to house almost anything, and number of drag marks suggest that it has been  used for just that.

name: Yao Guai Den, Tree Root
description: A charcoal tree's roots have been undermined for something's den.

name: Yao Guai Tunnels, Entrance
description: An Enclave camp is set up on the small bluff and is in disrepair, the area itself has multiple tunnels nearby.

name: Yao Guai Tunnels, Exit
description: A ramshackle door wedged into the cliffside hangs loosely open, a number of drag marks leading inside.
